description: This file defines the ProfilesController class responsible for handling HTTP requests related to user profiles in the ASP.NET Core application. It includes a single GET endpoint to retrieve profile details based on username.

classes.name: ProfilesController
classes.description: A controller class for handling profile-related endpoints, utilizing dependency injection for IMediator to send requests.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve profile details by username, using the mediator pattern.
